versions.content: Size of a length field for a chosen union The attribute sizeOfUnionLengthField of SOMEIPTransformationProps defines the size of a length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of the union for which the DataPrototypeTransformationProps is defined according to [TPS_SYST_02121].
